chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Subah al-Kinani, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The woman from whom her husband dies and he is absent, so her waiting period is from the day (the news) reaches her, whether the proof is established or not established.
ai.seo_question: When does the waiting period begin for a widow if her husband dies while he is absent?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that the iddah for a widow whose husband died in his absence begins upon the arrival of the news, irrespective of whether the testimony is formally validated. This ruling highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the actual receipt of information as the trigger for legal obligations, ensuring practical certainty in personal status matters. It underscores the importance of timely notification in Islamic jurisprudence to prevent uncertainty regarding marital eligibility.
